papers.journal: Lecture Notes in Computer Science (MICCAI 2021 proceedings, vol. 12908)

pipeline_steps.technique: Molecular cloning of plasmid constructs (Cre, Cre-dependent jGCaMP7b, bReaChes-mRuby3, NES-jRGECO1a, FLEX-eGFP) via subcloning/In-Fusion assembly

parameters.constructs: pCAG-Cre; pAAV-CAG-FLEX-jGCaMP7b-WPRE (Addgene #104497); pAAV-CaMKIIa-bReaChes-mRuby3 (subcloned from bReaChes-EYFP); pCAG-NES-jRGECO1a; pCAG-FLEX-eGFP

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: validated plasmid constructs for electroporation/viral packaging

pipeline_steps.technique: Generation of a floxed conditional Pdzd8 knockout mouse line (Pdzd8 F/F) by removing an FRT-flanked selection cassette and backcrossing to C57Bl/6
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: homozygous Pdzd8 F/F conditional knockout mouse line

pipeline_steps.technique: Western blot quantification of PDZD8 protein knockout in Cre-lentivirus-transduced primary embryonic cortical cultures from Pdzd8 F/F mice

parameters.culture: E15.5 Pdzd8 F/F cortical neurons, papain dissociation, plated on poly-D-lysine

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: quantified PDZD8 knockout efficiency by timepoint

pipeline_steps.technique: Stereotaxic viral injection and hippocampal CA1 imaging-cannula/headpost implantation, in variants for single-cell electroporation, population imaging, and electrophysiology cohorts

parameters.single_cell_cannula: custom stainless-steel cannula with angled pipette-entry ramp, etched glass coverslip with silicone-protected rectangular opening
parameters.population_virus: AAV5-CaMKIIa-mCherry-Cre (16-20 nl/DV, then AAV1-CaMKIIa-GCaMP6f 75 nl/DV one week later)

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: chronic hippocampal CA1 imaging or viral-expression access

pipeline_steps.technique: Two-photon-guided single-cell electroporation of CA1 pyramidal neurons for multi-plane or spine-level fluorescent-indicator/Cre-recombinase delivery

parameters.solution: 155 mM K-gluconate, 10 mM KCl, 10 mM HEPES, 4 mM KOH, 0.33 mM Alexa 488, pH 7.3, 316 mOsm
parameters.multiplane_plasmids: 50 ng/uL each of pCAG-Cre, pAAV-CAG-FLEX-jGCaMP7b-WPRE, pAAV-CaMKIIa-bReaChes-mRuby3
parameters.spine_plasmids: 50 ng/uL pCAG-Cre, 200 ng/uL pCAG-NES-jRGECO1a, 20 ng/uL pCAG-FLEX-eGFP
parameters.pipette: long-taper borosilicate (Warner G200-3), 2.5-6 MOhm tip resistance
parameters.electroporation: train of negative voltage pulses via stimulus isolator (AMPI) through a custom switch circuit

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: single electroporated CA1 pyramidal neurons expressing indicators/Cre

pipeline_steps.technique: BaseScope in situ hybridization validation of Pdzd8 knockout in electroporated CA1PNs with concurrent GFP immunohistochemistry, confocal imaging, and Cellpose-based signal segmentation

parameters.assay: BaseScope Detection Reagent Kit v2-RED (ACD) with RNA-Protein Co-detection Ancillary Kit
parameters.ihc: anti-GFP (chicken 1:50 or goat 1:300) with Alexa 488/647 secondaries; DAPI nuclear stain
parameters.imaging: Nikon A1 HD25 confocal, 1 um z-steps, 8 um sections
parameters.segmentation: Cellpose nuclear/cytoplasmic/punctate ROI detection, punctate-to-nucleus assignment by center-of-mass

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: per-cell Pdzd8 probe signal counts classified by GFP(+)/GFP(-) (KO/WT) status

pipeline_steps.technique: Ex vivo whole-cell current-clamp recording from virally-infected CA1 pyramidal neurons in acute hippocampal slices

parameters.cutting_solution: 195 mM sucrose, 10 mM NaCl, 15 mM glucose, 26 mM NaHCO3, 2.5 mM KCl, 1.25 mM NaH2PO4, 1.0 mM CaCl2, 2.0 mM MgCl2
parameters.internal_solution: 120 mM K-gluconate, 20 mM KCl, 10 mM HEPES, 4 mM NaCl, 4 mM MgATP, 0.3 mM TrisGTP, 14 mM phosphocreatine, pH 7.26, 296 mOsm
parameters.targeting: mCherry expression, visualized via pE-300 LED and far-red filter set
parameters.amplifier: MultiClamp 700B, Micro1401-3 digitizer, 50 kHz digitization, 1 kHz filter

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: whole-cell current-clamp recordings from Pdzd8 KO/WT CA1 pyramidal neurons

pipeline_steps.technique: Head-fixed virtual-reality random-foraging behavioral training on a spatially cued treadmill belt

parameters.reward_scheme: pseudorandom location, non-operant initial delivery + 3 s operant window at 50% reward rate
parameters.training_shaping: reward locations reduced from 10 to 1 per lap over training

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: trained mice performing random-foraging VR task

pipeline_steps.technique: In vivo two-photon Ca2+ imaging across three configurations: single-cell multi-plane (soma+dendrite piezo toggling), single-dendritic-spine (high-speed single-plane), and population imaging

parameters.main_system: Bruker 8 kHz resonant scanner, Chameleon Ultra II (920 nm green) + Fidelity-2 (1070 nm red)
parameters.spine_system: custom ScanImage-controlled 2P microscope, Chameleon Ultra II at 1030 nm for jRGECO1a
parameters.single_cell_multiplane: 40x objective, piezo toggling, 1.0-1.5x zoom, 5.05-11.89 Hz depending on jump distance
parameters.spine_imaging: 16x objective, 60x zoom, 128x128 px, 120 Hz, 45-60 s per dendritic segment

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: raw two-photon Ca2+ time series across imaging configurations
pipeline_steps.hardware: Bruker 8kHz resonant 2-photon microscope; custom ScanImage 2P microscope

pipeline_steps.technique: Single-cell optogenetic place-field induction via targeted LED photostimulation synchronized to two-photon image acquisition

parameters.led: 620 nm, ultra-fast/ultra-high-power (UHP-T-620-SR, Prizmatix), 30-40 mW at sample
parameters.protocol: 5 baseline laps, then 1 s photostimulation for 5 consecutive laps at a fixed track location
parameters.synchronization: custom pockel-blanking circuit gating LED during galvo flyback/piezo toggling

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: induced place field with pre/post-induction Ca2+ imaging data

pipeline_steps.technique: Motion correction and cross-day image registration: iterative target-based SIMA rigid registration for single-cell data, and affine ECC-warp cross-day alignment for population data

parameters.single_cell: modified rigid 2D SIMA registration seeded from somatic plane displacements, iterative decreasing-displacement refinement
parameters.frame_masking: frame-by-frame correlation to time-averaged FoV, z-score rolling-mean threshold, low-correlation frames masked NaN
parameters.population_cross_day: affine warp matrices via Enhanced Correlation Coefficient (ECC) maximization, 5000 iterations, OpenCV

pipeline_steps.technique: ROI curation: hand-drawn dendritic/somatic ROIs with morphological path-length annotation for single-cell data (FIJI), automated subROI segmentation, and Suite2p-based automated ROI detection with mCherry-based genotype classification for population data

parameters.single_cell_roi: hand-drawn on motion-corrected time-averaged FoVs, annotated with compartment type and branch-wise path length to soma
parameters.subroi_segmentation: 2 um segments along dendritic ROI long axis
parameters.population_roi: Suite2p detection on concatenated 5-session datasets, GUI-curated
parameters.genotype_classification: ROI overlay on aligned red (mCherry) channel to classify KO (mCherry+) vs. WT (mCherry-)

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: curated, annotated somatic/dendritic/spine ROIs with genotype labels

pipeline_steps.technique: Ridge-regression removal of velocity-related activity from neuropil-corrected calcium signals

parameters.model: ridge regression of velocity against neuropil-corrected signal
parameters.downstream_use: velocity-regressed DeltaF/F used for all analyses except velocity-modulation analysis itself

pipeline_steps.technique: Calculation of physiological tuning features: velocity modulation, context-mean activity, spatial rate maps, rate-map correlation/split-half reliability, sparsity, and reward selectivity/modulation indices

parameters.velocity_modulation: Pearson correlation between running velocity and max-normalized DeltaF/F
parameters.rate_maps: 5 cm spatial bins, Gaussian smoothing SD=10 cm
parameters.sparsity: spatial sparsity formula over rate-map bins
parameters.reward_selectivity: normalized difference in pre-reward-zone activity between the two reward zones

pipeline_steps.input_data_type: velocity-regressed DeltaF/F traces with position/context labels

pipeline_steps.technique: Generalized linear model PCA (GLM-PCA) of the cell-by-gene expression matrix to derive a transcriptomic axis (tPC2)

parameters.input: raw integer gene-count matrix, 610 cells x 500 genes
parameters.component_selection: second principal component (tPC2) identified as major transcriptomic continuum axis

pipeline_steps.technique: Random-forest classification of interneuron subclass from physiological features, with leave-one-animal-out cross-validation and balanced bagging

parameters.classes: Pvalb, Sst, Lamp5, Vip/Chrm2 (merged due to low n)
parameters.ensemble: 500 bagged random forests, balanced downsampling per iteration, 600 trees, max depth 10, min leaf size 5

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: predicted interneuron subclass and classification accuracy metrics

pipeline_steps.technique: MERFISH data quality control: transcript/gene count filtering, blank-probe contamination filtering, volume filtering, normalization, and doublet detection

parameters.doublet_detection: Scrublet on raw counts, up to 20 PCs, score cutoff 0.25

pipeline_steps.technique: Unbiased hierarchical cell-type clustering and subtype assignment from MERSCOPE transcriptomic profiles

parameters.preprocessing: per-cell normalization, log-transform, scaling, PCA (top 20 PCs), kNN graph (k=10)
parameters.resolution_selection: stability analysis across 30-50 seeds, resolutions 0.1-1.0, silhouette score and adjusted Rand index
parameters.clustering: Leiden algorithm, 3 hierarchical levels (class, subclass, type)
parameters.annotation: manual annotation referencing published hippocampal IN atlases, yielding 14 molecularly distinct IN types

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: hierarchical cell-class/subclass/type taxonomy with marker genes
